rubric.type: The chart type fits the intent and the shape of the result.
rubric.roles: The right columns hold the right roles.
rubric.title: The title says what is shown, in the caller's language, and is true.
rubric.units: Units and number formats are right.
rubric.honest: Nothing misleads: zero baseline, sort, readable labels, emphasis on what was asked.
rubric.explanation: The explanation is honest and in the caller's language.
